text: I’ve been coming here for years for blood tests and simple check-ups, and the service is always efficient and quick. It’s also much more affordable than other hospitals.

Overall, the experience was satisfactory. However, I would like to raise a concern regarding one staff member at the customer service counter on the ground floor of the new building, a chubby lady, approximately 50–53 years old, with short hair colored blonde mixed with black. Her behavior toward customers was unprofessional, including rolling her eyes and displaying an unfriendly attitude that came across as disrespectful and dismissive. As a frontline representative, customer service and professionalism are extremely important, and I believe this matter should be addressed appropriately.
Dr Klaikangwarn Rattanamongkol writes favourable medical reports for insurance companies. He said I was fit to fly despite being really sick. Avoid.

Went to this hospital today on the first floor room N1. The doctor spend 2 min on each patient. She didn’t examine me, didn’t send me to run any tests. When I asked if I need endoscopy (because I might have ulcer) she said no need. Prescribed pills without examining me without even testing my urine blood or anything. Then said : ok you can bring your poop tomorrow. When I asked to check my blood she said : go to a private clinic and pay if you wanna check your blood. This is weird for me , I came for help worrying about my health and got just a bunch of pills to cover the symptoms I have , not to heal the disease. What do I pay for insurance for if the hospital sends me to a private clinic ?

Want to thank the stuff of the hospital for their help today morning!
I am really impressed with the quality of medical help, nice approach of the nurses and doctors and the processing times. Thank you for your care!
Not impressed on the service of hospital, made appiintment with me st 9:30 am, 10:am psssed but nurse said the surgeon was busy with other operation case. This is unacceptable. Wasting the time.

I did surgery in this hospital and that is the only thing they have done in time. Disorganized structure of hospital management, huge waiting lines, people who book appointments wait in live queue with those who just came to hospital.

If you want to come for check up - consider 3-4 hours of your time is gone to nothing, considering that check up itself is less than 15 minutes.

They have new building and experienced doctors but if you need anything from them in time - Forget about it. They will keep asking for your documents over and over even if you come everyday.

I’m sitting in the queue right now for last hour and a half and my appointment was supposed to be from 9:30-11. I came 9 and still haven’t seen the doctor.

Just simple thing to do:
Separate incoming patients from those who have made an appointment and just make 2 different queues for people to go through faster.

Good luck everyone and get well soon
The Emergency Nurse in the Night Does'nt know how to handle the situation to my Son. 3rd time we came back and they keep asking what is happening but they have the records in their computer.

Here to highlight an amazing care and professional guideness and the most positive attitude and energy of a loving reception Nurse from Physio clinic at Mission hospital.
Jib - Sirinapa  Kongkrong you are an absolute legend and you are definitely example to the others how medical staff suppose to be. I don't see This ofter. And if leaders see this please reword this beautiful human anyway you can. It will keep her enthusiasm high and give a great example to others who might learn and follow.

World needs more of
Jib Sirinapa  Kongkrong

Thanks 🙏🏼 for all your help care and professionalism

This is the worst hospital for foreigners in Phuket! They let other patients go before you when they come in after you, they do not do it by severity of condition but by nationality if you're a native you'll get seen quicker and if not, you're made to feel like a second class citizen. It's absolutely disgusting! The staff would rather chat to each other than help their patients who are in pain. I sat for 30 mins in zone 1 before I realised I had to register first, even though I just registered downstairs. Unprofessional! They also got the medication wrong and I had to see the doctor again to prescribe different medication. This hospital OPD is a joke!

I had severe problems with my stomach (pain, vomiting, fever). It took approximately 2 hours (including blood test) to diagnose what caused the issues.
They are well-organized and staff speaks English. The costs are in my opinion decent. I've paid for the service and medicine 2'460 THB.
I do recommend The Mission Hospital Phuket.

I went to get stitches on a bleeding wound on my head. Received immediate treatment, staff was polite and the doctor did a very.good job. I went afterwards for wound dressing and the service was excellent and clean, only on my first visit I had to wait a bit longer because the hospital was very busy.
All in all good service.

I booked an appointment at the hospital two months ago, and when I went and had all the tests and the medical report from another hospital, they asked me to undergo new tests, knowing that I did not need to do that, as the report sent clearly indicated the necessity of performing an operation to remove the stone, but at Mission Hospital they do not really care about the patient and all their concerns are. It is collecting money from the patient to conduct more tests. I kept performing tests for an entire month with them, and between conducting the test and receiving the result, there was a week or more, and this is very bad. Finally, they told me that they did not have a surgery, urology, and endoscopy department to remove the stone. I was sent to another hospital. I think it was a bad experience.

If you are a foreigner, try not to use the services of this hospital. I have never seen such a racist attitude anywhere in Thailand. Previously, I went to this hospital because of the social insurance policy, then as a private person without insurance. If your insurance allows you to go to another hospital, go to another. Many times I have witnessed a situation when foreigners were deliberately detained for 4-8 hours, sending them to the end of the queue so that all Thai patients pass first. It doesn't matter when you come and how difficult your case is - you will wait a very, very long time. This was the case when I presented with a severe case of dengue fever, which was when my friend presented. with another disease. I have seen many times when foreigners quarreled over such behavior with the hospital staff, moreover, I myself was repeatedly forced to quarrel with the administration. They will simply suck money out of you, starve you out and disrespect, disrespect and disrespect. If such a racist attitude were in another country and towards other races, the management staff would have long been fired in disgrace!

1. Called in advance asked for CT. Staff said can do. Price 7500. Ok. Not the cheapest though.
2. Came at 15-00. They put you to the same waiting line asking with emergency patients and general insured patients.
I think when hospital is about to receive cash they should storage between insurance and cash patients as the hospital will get liquid money without waiting.
3. After waiting until 16-30 was said that doctor will have to see first and probably will do x-ray or skip CT scan. I don't want your X-ray! I asked for CT.
4. Said to wait another 2 hours just to visit doctor.

Waiting room has 40+ potentially ill patients without ventilation and without air conditioner. Only have fans to spread viruses.

So it will take same time to flight to Singapore probably then wait this queue.

Overall:
Service for paid customers: 0/5
Waiting times for paid customers: 0/5
Prices: 3/5.
Service quality: unknown.
Total:  1/5. Not recommended.

My recent general health checkup at Mission Hospital Phuket was a thoroughly positive experience. The experience of how God is there by its environment and promote healthy food. However, the wait times for some tests could be improved.
Very peaceful Christian hospital, I love the way of treatment, the Chaplain come and pray for sick people.
Went there after monkey bite. Got rabies and tetanus shot. The service was good, they spoke english and it took me only about 1 hour. Price for medicine and fees was 3200 baht.

The morning started out with a misunderstanding about how and where I was to register as a patient. The information given and the signs were not clear. However, once the staff realized the misunderstanding, they made the best effort to …

Wanted some basic information but could not speak with anyone who understood plain English, then I was disconnected, connected to a line where no one answered and also hung up on. When I finally spoke with someone who could speak English and I asked them for a procedure cost, they wouldn't tell me unless I came in person and made an appointment to see a doctor for an undetermined fee. I asked how many doctors at that hospital perform a particular procedure and was told that there are two and when I asked if she is able to give me any information on how long they have been doctors and what their experience level is, she told me that was confidential. Everyone was very rude and dismissive. Obviously I am not going to go there for any services. Shocking

My son cut his foot with opened door. We went to this clinic.

There are many waiting patients. We were waiting for 1,5 hour in the queue.

After this , doctors made x ray and stitch the cut.

Total price 2800 baht

I think this price is ok for this service

Had an infection on my hand, I was on antibiotics from a local pharmacy, but after a few days the wound still didn't look great so I decided to come here.

Staff were very helpful, everyone spoken enough English that the process was clear and easy.

Arrived on Monday at 11:00AM, was promptly seen for paperwork and then a nurse for initial assessment. Total wait time of 5 or 10 minutes. They scheduled an appointment for the same day at 2:00pm with a doctor.

At 2:00 I was seen immediately by the doctor! I was amazed that a big busy hospital like this was on time with appointments. The doctor wanted to get a tissue sample, so I went to another room and waited for a bit while things were prepared. The doctor came in, cleaned the wound and took a sample. I told the doctor I didn't want freezing as the wound didn't really hurt, and he listened and respected my choice.

I then waited about 20 minutes for the test results, and they came back negative, nothing to worry about.

Can't recommend this place enough to travellers! It would have been easier for them to just give me some mega dose of antibiotics and send me on my way (and they could have made more money off me). But they took their time, did it right, and were very professional.

And all said and done total cost: only 1500 Bhat! Can't beat that. Amazing service.

Quality care at a reasonable price. As a foreigner, I felt I was treated with the same respect and patience as locals. I was seen within the hour. The dr. I saw was very helpful and kind. The prices are very reasonable and the pharmacy staff explained everything very clearly to me in English. They also have a vegetarian restaurant.

Highly recommended for quality general care at affordable prices.

Mixed feelings.
+ 1st visit intake was efficient enough.
+ this hospital is clean. In 4 hours wait the floor was washed 3 times (yes, literally).
- staff at cashier is rude/ineffective, tried to prevent me to let me take a photo of my own diagnosis in my papers after the visit I paid for and spend 7 hours of my time for. Had to complain and almost beg for it. Like my own documents are some kind of secret 😜. F****g disgraceful.
- Christian propaganda and donation collection boxes are everywhere 😄 A bit too cyberpunk to my taste)
- had to wait for 5 min scan for half day
~ cost of services is soso, medium price
Verdict: OK-yish for farangs

It is a good hospital. We were directed here by our insurance company. Everybody is very kind and speaks english very well. After the registration on the reception we had a short screening and had a doctor consultation. They took our blood samples and after one hour we got results. We received necessary medications and injections. Everything was very fast and professional.

It's one of the best hospital in Phuket.
Vachira has more tools at their disposal but the waiting time is also longer.
It's usually my go to hospital in Phuket.
They are welcoming and the service is great.

Good hospital overall when it comes to equipment, care in wards. Bad at time of entry and exit with rude counter staff mainly at OPD cashier area. Need to be trained in customer care and basic first interaction with patients.

Poor hospital treatment experience I have ever had in my life. I have ever came here before long time ago but it never worse like this time. The doctor unprofessional and care less in ER room. The government hospital even have to wait for the long time is better. The quality of the service is worse than before.

Rang on 3rd Jan at 5pm trying to organise an appointment with haematology. The phone was handed around like a hot potato between about 4 or 5 staff who seemed to lack the capacity to make this appointment. Finally a lady (with her friends laughing in background) said to call back another day as it was a hospital holiday. She said heamatologist would be back in 2 days but you need to make an appointment beforehand but you can't make an appointment until she is back on Sunday. If that is how unprofessional they are I certainly won't be trusting them to put big needles in me. Better off elsewhere. PS. Unresponsive to emails also and the number on their website is incorrect.

It's a good hospital. Foreigners and locals treated the same. Basic. No specialist doctors. For that you need a private hospital or maybe the government hospital called Washira. Best private hospital Bangkok hospital Phuket but that's …

Not really what I expect from a “private” hospital, unnecessary long wait, and not enough staff. For injection you need to walk and get the drugs yourself in another building, and then walk back to give it to the nurse to inject. Never seen a hospital like this. If I have a serious sickness I believe I’d die here

Apparently they are closed on Saturday? Went to the OPD building and the lights were off,no staff. Was told to go to the emergency room only. Emergency room packed full of people with 1 nurse checking the vitals and 1 doctor examining people...so my advice is not to come here on Saturday if you do not want to waste your time.Did not get checked and left, as my insurance covers only this hospital.

The administration needs a lot of improvement. Was booked for CT scan 10am, they called and told me to come earlier at 6am. Came 6am the girl couldn't find patient record, told me to have blood test ( done 2 days ago), then have an Xray instead (no, appoIntment is for CT). Now been sitting for an hour waiting for someone to figure out what's going on.

We went to this hotel for a chest problem and the doctor did not spend 5 minutes on checking and issued me with medicine. After 2 days i got worse and went back to the hospital to be given another set of same medicine amd that did not even help. Today, we made an appointment with the doctor at 4pm. At 5pm i asked how many people more before we will be called and they answered 12 more and maybe called by 6pm. I said we had an appointment and they said that there are people who came in the morning. So appointments are not even acknowledged here and you still need to queu! They should've said that they don't acknowledge appointments so we should've went earlier. This is a mess.

Though this hospital might look a bit old and tired it offers great value for your money.
Here you are actually treated like a patient and not an ATM - and they genuinely …

Amazing hospital with doctors who really care about you. There is usually a dedicated staff member who deals with foreigners at reception and all the doctors speak perfect English.

Without generalising, other hospitals on Phuket have a bad habit of seeing worried and sick people as cash cows. Sending you for every test possible, overcharging and not giving an informative diagnosis.

Mission is very different. They get to the route problem and try to help you. The price is very fair. I paid 4,400B and i saw two doctors (one specialist) and have some quite advance tests.

Chaotic, disorganised, bureacratic, not clear where to go, what the process is.... My hotel manager booked me an appointment for a PCR test with fit to fly certificate at 8.30am for $3200thb. Turns out no appointments, cost is $3700thb including fit to fly, and I was there for hours. Unlike everybody else in the world, they do not email the certificate and results. I have to now go back again to get the results. More taxi costs and probably more waiting. Do not go here for fit to fly !!!!

Mission Hospital Phuket
Had to watch for over an hour the Nurse doing useless and inefficient Paperwork until I finally was able to see the Doctor to get some Insulin refill from Sanofi which I use for Years.
In Switzerland I pay without a Recipe or Doctor visit for 6 Capsules 86 CHF (3133Thai Baht) direct from the Pharmacy. At Mission Hospital I had to pay a total of 8363.-Thai Baht (230CHF)
I asked why so high? Answer, Lab and Doctors Fee, which Lab? I have no clue as only my weight and Blood pressure was checked by a Nurse, Blood sugar was never checked, but the Doctor told me how much Insulin i have to inject, how is this possible without checking my Blood?  the Doctor just asked me if I know this Medicine and know how to use it. In addition he told me that my Blood pressure is high. He recommended some Medicine which he subscribed me 100 Pills which is included in the 8363 Baht

As  a retired US expat and Military veteran. I recently visited the Mission Hospital. Mr. David John Dundas.

I was diagnosed with 'mild-depression' and put on a prescription of meds to help me cope. The therapy and the medication helped, but the admin staff show little care for people and treat you as if you're at your local Tesco in line for …

I can’t blame doctors or nurses. It’s purely about healthcare structure in this country.

Quick and easy experience getting a last minute PCR covid test. From arrival it took about 30 minutes for the entire process and I received my results 4 hours after I was tested. The cost was 1800 Baht which is much less than anywhere else in Phuket at this time.

Don’t recommend this hospital to anyone, I was trying to get consultation with the ENT doctor and made appointment booking one week in advance .
When I came there they said if I wanna see ENT Doctor I need to get a Covid antigen test which is cost 800Tbaht, but I’m fully vaccinated and don’t have any symptoms

They said they’ll send me the results by email within one day, but I still didn’t get it… I wrote two emails in case they’ll make mistakes…

all I got was 2 minutes of conversation with a regular guy therapist with vague english, he didn’t even look at my tonsils and couldn’t understand my problem properly… but the interesting fact was that he recommended me antibiotics and make a covid-test I don’t really understand why doctor/therapist gives prescriptions for antibiotics without a detailed study of the problem.

After that I just went to the government hospital in Patong and got everything I wanted without any covid tests for only 240 Baht, I received detailed advice from a competent ENT specialist and she didn’t recommend me to use antibiotics as it may be too resistant for future diseases.

PEOPLE PLEASE AVOID THIS PLACE! Better go to the Government hospitals

Three times i have been treated at this hospital.First time for dengue fever,second time for rabies course of shots due to cat bite,and most recently for a severe lung infection and was admitted for 2 nights.Overall i can only praise the …

If really have issues , the patient maybe will die here....
Don’t come here if you are wanting western standards or even what would be considered basics. Starting with Aircon and adequate (in some parts any) seating. …

I have tried calling them 3 times to enquire about social security and what it covers. Eventually when I get through to someone who speaks English, they just hang up on me. Happened 3 times in a row. One of them told me to call 2703, a number which does not exist. Shocking service.
